faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Kalyani Project Laboratory Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AIIMS Kalyani Project Laboratory Assistant recruitment is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Laboratory Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Laboratory Assistant post at AIIMS Kalyani.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Laboratory Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Class 12th (10+2) with B.MLT, Dip.MLT, or BSS Dip.MLT with First Division marks from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Laboratory Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Laboratory Assistant post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Laboratory Assistant role?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary for the Project Laboratory Assistant is Rs. 27,000 PM + HRA 30% @ Rs. 8100 PM, totaling Rs. 35,100/- PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the official AIIMS Kalyani website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Kalyani Project Laboratory Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Laboratory Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Laboratory Assistant position is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
